Corelink 2-Port EPON OLT – High-Performance Passive Optical Network Solution

Next-Gen 2-Port EPON OLT for Scalable & High-Speed Fiber Connectivity

The Corelink 2-Port EPON OLT is a compact, high-performance optical line terminal designed for fiber-to-the-x (FTTX), ISP networks, and enterprise applications. This cost-effective and scalable solution enables seamless communication between Optical Network Units (ONUs) and Optical Distribution Networks (ODN), forming a passive fiber-optic network with ultra-fast speeds and enhanced reliability.


With 2 SFP PON ports, a 1:64 splitter ratio per port, and a maximum capacity of 128 ONUs, this OLT delivers high bandwidth, full line-speed Layer 2/3 switching, and extended transmission distances up to 20km. Its 1U rack-mountable design with an integrated cooling fan ensures efficient heat dissipation and long-term durability.


Key Features 

  • High-Performance 2-Port EPON OLT – Supports up to 128 ONUs with a 1:64 splitter ratio per PON port.
  • Extended Fiber Reach – Supports fiber-optic transmission up to 20km, ensuring broad network coverage.
  • Universal ONU Compatibility – Works with any brand ONUs, providing maximum flexibility.
  • Multiple Uplink Options – 2 x 1000M RJ45 uplink ports for high-speed data transmission.
  • Advanced Network Management – Supports WEB, SNMP, and CLI-based management.
  • Compact 1U Rack Design – Integrated cooling fan for enhanced stability and heat dissipation.
  • Ideal for ISP, Enterprise & FTTX Deployments – Supports IPTV, VoIP, data services, and smart surveillance networks.


Technical Highlights

Port Configuration

  • 2 x SFP PON Ports – Supports high-speed fiber connectivity with a 1:64 splitter ratio per port.
  • 2 x 1000M Ethernet RJ45 Uplink Ports – Ensures flexible and high-speed networking.
  • 1 x 10/100M RJ45 Management Port – Supports CLI, SNMP, and WEB-based management.


Network Performance & Capacity

  • Maximum Splitter Ratio – 1:64 per PON port, supporting up to 128 ONUs.
  • Long-Distance Fiber Transmission – Supports up to 20km fiber reach.
  • Multi-Service Support – Delivers IP voice, data, IPTV, and high-definition video streaming.
  • QoS & VLAN Support – Optimized traffic prioritization & network segmentation.
  • Powerful Security Features – Supports AES-128 encryption for secure network communication.


Ideal Applications

  • FTTX & FTTH Deployments – Seamless fiber-optic connectivity for residential and business users.
  • ISP & Telecom Networks – Scalable fiber networking solution for Internet Service Providers.
  • Enterprise & Data Centers – Reliable high-speed fiber network infrastructure.
  • Smart Cities & Surveillance – Supports high-definition CCTV and security applications.
  • Rural & Urban Fiber Broadband Expansion – Ideal for towns, villages, and metro network deployment.


Technical Specifications

  • Optical & Performance Parameters
  • Operating Wavelength – 1310 nm (RX) / 1490 nm (TX)
  • Optical Power – +0 to +7 dBm
  • Receiving Sensitivity – -27 dBm
  • Maximum Transmission Distance – 20km
  • Maximum ONU Capacity – 128 ONUs
  • MAC Address Table – 8K


Management & Protocols

  • Network Protocols – Supports IEEE 802.3, 802.3u, 802.3ab, 802.3ah (EPON Standard).
  • VLAN & QoS Support – IEEE 802.1Q VLAN, IEEE 802.1P QoS.
  • Network Management – Supports SNMP, CLI, GUI & WEB-based control.
  • Security Features – Supports DHCP Snooping, ARP Snooping, and AES-128 encryption.


Power & Environmental Conditions

  • Power Supply – AC 220V
  • Power Consumption – 11W
  • Operating Temperature – -10°C to 55°C
  • Storage Temperature – -40°C to 70°C
  • Humidity – 5% to 90% (non-condensing)


Why Choose Corelink 2-Port EPON OLT?

  • Reliable & Scalable Fiber Networking Solution – Supports high-speed, long-distance fiber connectivity.
  • Future-Proof & Compatible with Any ONU – Works with all ONU brands for flexible deployment.
  • Advanced Network Management – Easy monitoring & configuration via WEB, SNMP, and CLI.
  • Energy-Efficient & Compact Design – Low power consumption (11W) with an integrated cooling fan.
  • Cost-Effective for ISPs, Enterprises & Smart Networks – Ideal for FTTX, IPTV, VoIP, and surveillance.
